question: After India’s 29ₜₕ state, Telangana, was created, which of the following parties formed the first government in the state?
solution:
Option **1** is correct: Telangana Rashtra Samithi (TRS)

__
 
• The Telangana state was inaugurated formally on **June 2ⁿd 2014**.
 
• In the General Elections held in April 2014,** Telangana Rashtra Samithi**__ emerged victorious by winning 63 of the 119 seats and formed the government.** Sri K Chandrashekar Rao** was sworn in as the First Chief Minister of Telangana.
 
• The State Bird - Palapitta (Indian Roller or Blue Jay).
 
• The State Animal - Jinka (Deer).
 
• The State Tree - Jammi Chettu (Prosopis Cineraria).
 
• The State Flower - Tangedu (Tanner’s Cassia).
